description: RMSNorm backward (dx, dscale and dbias outputs, saved inverse RMS as a graph input) in the HIP_MLOPS_ENGINE region: rank 4 or 5 (RMSnormBwdPlan.cpp:120, IValidator::validateDimensionCount ApplicabilityChecks.cpp:31), NCHW/NCDHW or NHWC/NDHWC packed strides (IValidator::validateSupportedLayout, ApplicabilityChecks.cpp:76), the float/half/bfloat16 combinations of x, dx, dy, scale, dscale and dbias that the engine and both references accept (pure, mixed io, mixed affine, float x with half or bfloat16 dy) with a float inverse RMS, scale, dscale and dbias covering a trailing suffix of the dims (leading dims 1) and inv_rms keeping the leading dims (suffix dims 1). Axis k is the first normalized axis, as in the RMSNorm space. x and dx always share one dtype, as in every quick row. The inv_rms fill range 0.9 to 1.5 is the quick sweep's tuned range for uid 4. Template: quick RMSNormBackward/Default, the topology with the full tensor set (dbias output). Domain axis: x and dy take the domain fill, with large narrowed to scale 4 because dscale and dbias are sums of dy*x*rstd and dy over the batch groups and overflow half at scale 32; the nan and inf domains plant exactly one non-finite element in dy (uid 3; fraction 1e-12 rounds to zero and the special fill plants at least one, FillInputs.cpp:494-498) and keep x free(-1,1) and inv_rms free(0.9, 1.5). One element is the only poison that leaves finite elements in every output: dscale is a sum over all groups, so a poisoned inv_rms group makes every dscale element non-finite and the comparison fails for lack of a finite reference element (NonFiniteMask.hpp:31); a poisoned dy element touches one dbias and dscale element and the dx row of its group, so the constraint below requires at least two groups and at least two normalized elements. Alignment and placement axes: tensor_patches sets the declared alignment of every tensor (uids 0 to 6, all device tensors) to the alignment axis, and placement (default, exact or under; exact when under would need alignment 1) acts on x (uid 6).

derive.dims_x: [n, c, h, w] if ndim == 4 else [n, c, d, h, w]
derive.dims_p: [1, pc, ph, pw] if ndim == 4 else [1, pc, pd, ph, pw]
derive.dims_s: [n, sc, sh, sw] if ndim == 4 else [n, sc, sd, sh, sw]
derive.xs_h: w if layout == 'nchw' else w * c
derive.xs_d: h * w if layout == 'nchw' else h * w * c
derive.xs_c: d * h * w if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ps_h: pw if layout == 'nchw' else pw * pc
derive.ps_d: ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else ph * pw * pc
derive.ps_c: pd * ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ss_h: sw if layout == 'nchw' else sw * sc
derive.ss_d: sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else sh * sw * sc
derive.ss_c: sd * sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.stride_x: [xs_n, xs_c, xs_h, xs_w] if ndim == 4 else [xs_n, xs_c, xs_d, xs_h, xs_w]
derive.stride_p: [ps_n, ps_c, ps_h, ps_w] if ndim == 4 else [ps_n, ps_c, ps_d, ps_h, ps_w]
derive.stride_s: [ss_n, ss_c, ss_h, ss_w] if ndim == 4 else [ss_n, ss_c, ss_d, ss_h, ss_w]
derive.dom_kind: dm if dm in ['nonzero', 'zeros', 'large', 'subnormal'] else ('fixed' if dm == 'constant' else 'free')
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if dm == 'narrow' else (-8 if dm == 'wide' else (0.25 if dm == 'positive' else (0.5 if dm == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if dm == 'narrow' else (8 if dm == 'wide' else (4 if dm == 'positive' else (0.5 if dm == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.bwd_term_max: 24 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 0)
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.reason: the first normalized axis must be one of the non-batch axes: scale dim 0 must be 1 and the normalized suffix must start after it (detail/Utilities.hpp:323 validateScaleNormalizedShape, called from RMSNormBackwardNode.hpp:87)

constraints.rule: (x_dtype == 'float' and p_dtype == 'float') or (x_dtype != 'float' and ((dy_dtype == x_dtype and p_dtype in ['float', x_dtype]) or (dy_dtype == 'float' and p_dtype == 'float')))
constraints.reason: x and dx share one dtype, scale, dscale and dbias share one dtype (RMSnormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:41 checkTensorDataTypesSupported, called from checkBwdTensorConfigSupported at :221), and the CPU and GPU references register only these (dy, x, scale, dx) combinations with fp32 compute: float everywhere; half or bfloat16 dy with float x, scale and dx; half or bfloat16 x and dx with dy equal to x and scale float or equal to x; half or bfloat16 x and dx with float dy and float scale (RMSNormBwdSignatureKey.hpp:99 getPlanBuilders, GpuRMSNormSignatureKey.hpp:254 getPlanBuilders)
GPU reference cost ceiling (RFC 0023 section 14); it also keeps outerSize * stride far below UINT32_MAX, the work-group limit in RMSnormBwdPlan.cpp:132

constraints.rule: domain not in ['nan', 'inf'] or (n * sc * sd * sh >= 2 and pc * pd * ph * pw >= 2)
constraints.reason: the special fill plants at least one non-finite element in dy (FillInputs.cpp:494-498): with a single normalization group the whole dx is that group's row, and with a single normalized element the whole dscale and dbias are that column, so a reference with no finite element in an output fails (NonFiniteMask.hpp:31)

dscale and dbias are written in p_dtype and each element sums bwd_terms = n * sc * sd * sh terms (the product of the dims_s the saved inverse RMS covers) of dy and of dy * x * inv_rms; a sign-definite dy and x (positive: at most 4 each, inv_rms at most 1.5, so a dscale term of at most 24; constant: 0.5) makes that sum grow linearly with the term count, and past half's largest value 65504 the output is inf, which the default validator fails (probed on gfx950: 421848 terms of positive dy in half, RMSNormBackward s5068); bfloat16 does not overflow but its 8-bit mantissa rounds a sum that large to a few units, so the same bound applies; the zero-mean domains grow with the square root of the term count and stay far below it, and a float p_dtype is not bounded
